candidates.review_note: Compute point-to-game probability by summing wins before deuce and the exact two-point-cycle absorption probability after deuce. At set level, alternate serve/receive game probabilities; upon 5-5, each two-game block either wins both, loses both, or returns to the same tie with the same server, giving the closed absorption ratio. Propagate all earlier game scores explicitly. The first server alternates between sets as the statement specifies, independently of how many games occurred in the previous set. Finally propagate best-of-five set scores until three wins, cache identical input pairs, and format percentages to four decimals.
